set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5P210DBHC1ST4VR73NYD5C on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T19:50:18.894003Z.

Run the three frozen decomposition lanes from B0 without retuning the matcher or HalfFlow budget2x.

Decision table: if oracle matches cannot be assimilated fold-free, reject/fix the projector or assimilator. If oracle assimilation succeeds but HalfFlow still stalls far below ANTs, investigate fine objective, regularizer, rank-one scaling, or midpoint interpolation. If oracle plus HalfFlow approaches ANTs but block plus HalfFlow does not, improve match confidence/features. If block plus HalfFlow approaches oracle, retain robust affine plus BasinBridge plus HalfFlow as the candidate architecture.

Acceptance: report pre/post weighted match residual percentiles, true-CC loss, internal-label Dice/surface metrics where available, det-J distribution and folds, export diagnostics, accepted alpha/rounds, runtime and peak memory. Include synthetic 2/4/8/12 mm capture and the same-affine sub18 diagnostic. Emit a validator-backed non-decisional receipt; architectural promotion still requires at least five labeled development pairs.
set.title: BasinBridge B4: run oracle, matcher, and refinement decomposition
